method: Every shipped gap channel in classification.json was read at the classified revision in the tool's shipped code (tests, examples, benchmarks, demos and CI scripts excluded).

confirmed: a shipped path uses the gapped capability, so the tool fails or misbehaves after the hardfork until the dependency moves; not-reached: shipped code uses the dependency only outside it; undetermined: reading cannot decide.
Each decision quotes the lines it rests on; check-leads --verify-sources re-reads every quote at its pinned revision.

leads.summary: Opens a node-to-client connection and polls LocalTxMonitor; gouroboros v0.208.5 cannot negotiate V23 with an 11.2 node.
Decodes every mempool transaction through gouroboros ledger types that predate the Dijkstra transaction format.
txtop imports only the gouroboros root, ledger and ledger/common packages and uses LocalTxMonitor; it reads no blocks or protocol parameters and applies no ledger or consensus rules.
plutigo is an indirect module requirement; txtop imports no plutigo package.
Its whole purpose is a node-to-client bridge (chain-sync, state query, tx monitor, tx submission) on gouroboros v0.202.7, which stops before V23. The repository is archived.
Decodes submitted transactions and reads current protocol parameters through pre-Dijkstra ledger types.
Consensus and ledger-rule surfaces are not exercised by an identifiable shipped path; left to execution.
Signing decodes the supplied transaction with gouroboros v0.212.5, which predates the target Dijkstra transaction types.

leads.summary: Bursa never opens a node connection; it uses gouroboros for network names, keys and ledger types.
Bursa decodes no blocks, and reads the fee-relevant protocol parameters from cardano-cli JSON with its own parser rather than gouroboros types.
Bursa generates KES and VRF keys and builds transactions; whether Peras/Leios participation or the Dijkstra rules affect them needs execution.
plutigo is indirect in the root module and imported only by tests.
The installer uses gouroboros only to resolve network names.
The probabilistic light client decodes Cardano blocks and pool certificates with gouroboros v0.205.4, before Dijkstra block and transaction types.

plutigo is indirect in the light-client modules with no import.
